Palace of Westhaleg, Londinium

raw: Even before Londinium was a nomadic city, the Palace of Westhaleg stood here.
content: Even before Londinium was a nomadic city, the Palace of Westhaleg stood here.

raw: Its name was originally plain Westhaleg. The Draco royal family convened its ministers here in this palace, and used their beloved gold and ruby to decorate the outer walls.
content: Its name was originally plain Westhaleg. The Draco royal family convened its ministers here in this palace, and used their beloved gold and ruby to decorate the outer walls.

raw: Said decorations went up in flames during the Great Fire three hundred years ago. Still, the building's skeleton remained, and it bore witness to the first Aslan king's coronation.
content: Said decorations went up in flames during the Great Fire three hundred years ago. Still, the building's skeleton remained, and it bore witness to the first Aslan king's coronation.

raw: Thereafter, Westhaleg formally became the Palace of Westhaleg, to commemorate the age of peace and prosperity founded by the Draco and Aslan kings in joint.
content: Thereafter, Westhaleg formally became the Palace of Westhaleg, to commemorate the age of peace and prosperity founded by the Draco and Aslan kings in joint.

raw: Twenty-six years ago, the last Aslan king was captured in the same place by Parliament's standing forces.
content: Twenty-six years ago, the last Aslan king was captured in the same place by Parliament's standing forces.

raw: And now, this is no longer the building where the Victorian Parliament assembles.
content: And now, this is no longer the building where the Victorian Parliament assembles.

raw: Sat at the conference table is but one person, not Draco, nor Aslan, but Sarkaz.
content: Sat at the conference table is but one person, not Draco, nor Aslan, but Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]...still no sign of movement from the Duke of Gododdin... ever since the Viscount's life was attempted, our activity in the demesne has been greatly restricted...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: ...still no sign of movement from the Duke of Gododdin... ever since the Viscount's life was attempted, our activity in the demesne has been greatly restricted...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]...lavish salons held every night at the Duke of Normandy's residence, but the flow of raw steel is extremely suspect, and all intelligence personnel have turned up empty-handed...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: ...lavish salons held every night at the Duke of Normandy's residence, but the flow of raw steel is extremely suspect, and all intelligence personnel have turned up empty-handed...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]...any sound from Dublinn is drowned out by the Duke of Wellington's high-speed battleships roaring. We've as of yet been unable to penetrate into the Iron Duke's duchy, but no other duke would be able to impede the veteran, without a doubt.
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: ...any sound from Dublinn is drowned out by the Duke of Wellington's high-speed battleships roaring. We've as of yet been unable to penetrate into the Iron Duke's duchy, but no other duke would be able to impede the veteran, without a doubt.

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]...the Marquess and co. have finally given up on the Duke of Stafford's inheritance... the Duke of Caster admitted envoys and gifts on New Year's Eve...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: ...the Marquess and co. have finally given up on the Duke of Stafford's inheritance... the Duke of Caster admitted envoys and gifts on New Year's Eve...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]...activity from all dukes has been growing increasingly frequent since last winter. It may be a sign they're about to 'reach a conclusion.' Preparations for Londinium remain at the same pace as... hold for a moment, sorry.
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: ...activity from all dukes has been growing increasingly frequent since last winter. It may be a sign they're about to 'reach a conclusion.' Preparations for Londinium remain at the same pace as... hold for a moment, sorry.

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]What? You're sure... Leithanien? Three days ago? This is too slow! ...Yes, it looks like they've finally found results after their diplomatic peacemaking...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: What? You're sure... Leithanien? Three days ago? This is too slow! ...Yes, it looks like they've finally found results after their diplomatic peacemaking...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]Er. New cipher's just been decoded. It's word from the frontline, General. Yes, I need to... notify you ASAP...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: Er. New cipher's just been decoded. It's word from the frontline, General. Yes, I need to... notify you ASAP...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]Three days ago, the Empresses' Voice grandiloquently left the Duke of Windermere's demesne... er...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: Three days ago, the Empresses' Voice grandiloquently left the Duke of Windermere's demesne... er...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"](Gulps) We didn't discover contact between the two sides in time, but, just today...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: (Gulps) We didn't discover contact between the two sides in time, but, just today...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]A city... a fortress changed course, and is sailing straight for Londinium. The one that's been nearest us over the past two years... er...
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: A city... a fortress changed course, and is sailing straight for Londinium. The one that's been nearest us over the past two years... er...

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]It's pushing directly from Leithanien into the Victorian border, nearing the ravine. Er, yes, it's the Kurfürst's archenemy... Duke Windermere's army.
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: It's pushing directly from Leithanien into the Victorian border, nearing the ravine. Er, yes, it's the Kurfürst's archenemy... Duke Windermere's army.

raw: [name="Voice on the Terminal"]Duke Windermere announces internationally... this is to 'avoid Catastrophe.'
speaker: Voice on the Terminal
content: Duke Windermere announces internationally... this is to 'avoid Catastrophe.'

raw: Silence once again hangs over the hall. But at this moment, with his eyes shut tight, Theresis sees the thick fog outside of Londinium.
content: Silence once again hangs over the hall. But at this moment, with his eyes shut tight, Theresis sees the thick fog outside of Londinium.

raw: Once it clears, the battle will come, right on schedule.
content: Once it clears, the battle will come, right on schedule.

raw: Footsteps break through Theresis's train of thought.
content: Footsteps break through Theresis's train of thought.

raw: He is forced to open his eyes.
content: He is forced to open his eyes.
Ther...
Theresis.

speaker: Theresis
content: It's you.

speaker: Theresa
content: Were you asleep?

speaker: Theresis
content: ...Perhaps.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The Victorian dukes are a cunning lot. They meticulously sift through every word of intel that flows into Londinium, making the Sarkaz lose their heads.
speaker: Theresis
content: The Victorian dukes are a cunning lot. They meticulously sift through every word of intel that flows into Londinium, making the Sarkaz lose their heads.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The advantage isn't ours in this gamble. Yet neither have we been at a disadvantage.
speaker: Theresis
content: The advantage isn't ours in this gamble. Yet neither have we been at a disadvantage.

raw: [name="Theresa"]The Military Commission's business is always endless. Such is our history's fragility... even a single comment on a piece of information awry would suffice to forever damn Kazdel.
speaker: Theresa
content: The Military Commission's business is always endless. Such is our history's fragility... even a single comment on a piece of information awry would suffice to forever damn Kazdel.

raw: [name="Theresa"]But even now... now as we stand in Londinium, things have hardly changed much. You're still as weary as ever.
speaker: Theresa
content: But even now... now as we stand in Londinium, things have hardly changed much. You're still as weary as ever.

speaker: Theresis
content: No, one thing has changed.

speaker: Theresis
content: You're here.

speaker: Theresa
content: Yes, I am.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The breadth of possibilities has crossed my mind, if you were to take my head. Perhaps you would make a much cleaner job of it than I.
speaker: Theresis
content: The breadth of possibilities has crossed my mind, if you were to take my head. Perhaps you would make a much cleaner job of it than I.

raw: [name="Theresa"]You would never think that way yourself. That was a hypothetical put forth by Manfred.
speaker: Theresa
content: You would never think that way yourself. That was a hypothetical put forth by Manfred.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I am always in need of some differing voices.
speaker: Theresis
content: I am always in need of some differing voices.

speaker: Theresa
content: What's on your mind now?

speaker: Theresis
content: A dream.

speaker: Theresa
content: Oh?

raw: [name="Theresis"]I saw us still in Londinium, yet unarmed.
speaker: Theresis
content: I saw us still in Londinium, yet unarmed.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Clouds enveloping this city, black stones growing everywhere, and the Sarkaz... the Sarkaz there in the way, between Catastrophe and the crowd.
speaker: Theresis
content: Clouds enveloping this city, black stones growing everywhere, and the Sarkaz... the Sarkaz there in the way, between Catastrophe and the crowd.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Once the disaster lifted, Londinium's city gates were wide open to us, and the Victorians stood flanking the streets, cheering and welcoming us in.
speaker: Theresis
content: Once the disaster lifted, Londinium's city gates were wide open to us, and the Victorians stood flanking the streets, cheering and welcoming us in.

raw: [name="Theresis"]We entered this palace, and the one sat on the throne no longer feared the black stones that grew from us, and took our hands.
speaker: Theresis
content: We entered this palace, and the one sat on the throne no longer feared the black stones that grew from us, and took our hands.

speaker: Theresis
content: He called the Sarkaz—

speaker: Theresis
content: 'Friends.'

speaker: Theresa
content: It sounds unfathomable.

speaker: Theresis
content: There was more.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I saw Vampire, Nachzehrer and Wendigo set foot together into reaches more northern than even Ursus, casting fragments of strange monsters back unto the frigid sky.
speaker: Theresis
content: I saw Vampire, Nachzehrer and Wendigo set foot together into reaches more northern than even Ursus, casting fragments of strange monsters back unto the frigid sky.

raw: [name="Theresis"]And I saw Banshee and Damazti venture to parts more southern than even Iberia, walls against the ocean's dissent within the boundless water.
speaker: Theresis
content: And I saw Banshee and Damazti venture to parts more southern than even Iberia, walls against the ocean's dissent within the boundless water.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Countless Sarkaz giving their lives for this land—
speaker: Theresis
content: Countless Sarkaz giving their lives for this land—

raw: [name="Theresis"]And Aslan, Draco, Feline, Caprinae, Liberi... stood together with them.
speaker: Theresis
content: And Aslan, Draco, Feline, Caprinae, Liberi... stood together with them.

speaker: Theresa
content: Stood together?

raw: [name="Theresis"]Yes. The Sarkaz were no longer the nomads excluded. The land embraced us, and we had roots anew.
speaker: Theresis
content: Yes. The Sarkaz were no longer the nomads excluded. The land embraced us, and we had roots anew.

speaker: Theresa
content: This dream...

speaker: Theresis
content: This dream was not mine.

raw: [name="Theresis"]This scenario all originates from what you once described to me... a future the Sarkaz could have.
speaker: Theresis
content: This scenario all originates from what you once described to me... a future the Sarkaz could have.

speaker: Theresa
content: I remember.

raw: [name="Theresa"]But you told me, then, that my ideals were too distant, that it was not only our enemies who could never comprehend me, but neither could the Sarkaz.
speaker: Theresa
content: But you told me, then, that my ideals were too distant, that it was not only our enemies who could never comprehend me, but neither could the Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Theresa"]A myriad years of grievances became our weapons one and all, and all imposed upon me.
speaker: Theresa
content: A myriad years of grievances became our weapons one and all, and all imposed upon me.

raw: [name="Theresa"]You also told me that the flames of war within the Sarkaz would tear them apart before I led them to that future, that was more likely in all respects.
speaker: Theresa
content: You also told me that the flames of war within the Sarkaz would tear them apart before I led them to that future, that was more likely in all respects.

raw: [name="Theresis"]But you begrudge giving up any possibility, even if it may be but a nascent spark.
speaker: Theresis
content: But you begrudge giving up any possibility, even if it may be but a nascent spark.

speaker: Theresis
content: You've also said...

raw: [name="Theresis"]That this world once was only the Sarkaz's. That the Ancients and Elders wrested our homeland from our forebears' hands.
speaker: Theresis
content: That this world once was only the Sarkaz's. That the Ancients and Elders wrested our homeland from our forebears' hands.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Their souls in death still murmur the Sankta's betrayal, how the Royal Court withers like autumn leaves, how our bloodline is lost in howls of grief, how ridiculous the sinners are in forgetting history, and how Kazdel's ruins strew all across Terra.
speaker: Theresis
content: Their souls in death still murmur the Sankta's betrayal, how the Royal Court withers like autumn leaves, how our bloodline is lost in howls of grief, how ridiculous the sinners are in forgetting history, and how Kazdel's ruins strew all across Terra.

speaker: Theresis
content: And then, they—cry out—

speaker: Theresis
content: —'The Sarkaz have invaded our homeland.'

raw: [name="Theresis"]So better that the Sarkaz believe in the fight. The fight can herd our destinies together as one. Better that than...
speaker: Theresis
content: So better that the Sarkaz believe in the fight. The fight can herd our destinies together as one. Better that than...

speaker: Theresis
content: ...Peace.

raw: [name="Theresis"]This isn't fair. To rule is a method of coexistence too.
speaker: Theresis
content: This isn't fair. To rule is a method of coexistence too.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Terra will perish by its own hand before it confronts those time-old questions.
speaker: Theresa
content: Terra will perish by its own hand before it confronts those time-old questions.

raw: [name="Theresis"]But our homeland would be more magnificent than the many of the Seaborn. Our hexcrafters would hold the northern menace at bay. Our knowledge, all-encompassing, would dispel Originium, end the Catastrophes...
speaker: Theresis
content: But our homeland would be more magnificent than the many of the Seaborn. Our hexcrafters would hold the northern menace at bay. Our knowledge, all-encompassing, would dispel Originium, end the Catastrophes...

raw: [name="Theresis"]Before all that, the Sarkaz must reach an answer.
speaker: Theresis
content: Before all that, the Sarkaz must reach an answer.

speaker: Theresa
content: You're right... they must.

raw: [name="Theresis"]This is a conversation we've had countless times, but now, you can hear their voices clearly. You can make real contact with their ancient souls' tendrils. So tell me, Theresa—
speaker: Theresis
content: This is a conversation we've had countless times, but now, you can hear their voices clearly. You can make real contact with their ancient souls' tendrils. So tell me, Theresa—

raw: [name="Theresis"]—Did this myriad of years of all the Teekaz souls that lived and breathed, and passed from life to the other shore in death—did they ever receive a momentary respite?
speaker: Theresis
content: —Did this myriad of years of all the Teekaz souls that lived and breathed, and passed from life to the other shore in death—did they ever receive a momentary respite?

speaker: Theresa
content: I've already failed, Theresis.

speaker: Theresis
content: Because you're a move behind.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Because at this moment, it is we that stand here.
speaker: Theresa
content: Because at this moment, it is we that stand here.

speaker: Theresis
content: Here...

speaker: Theresis
content: Londinium.

speaker: Theresis
content: Tell me, Theresa.

raw: [name="Theresis"]When you stand atop The Shard and look at this city, what is it you see?
speaker: Theresis
content: When you stand atop The Shard and look at this city, what is it you see?

raw: [name="Theresa"]That Victoria is a nation lush with ingenuity.
speaker: Theresa
content: That Victoria is a nation lush with ingenuity.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Without a doubt. In a few short centuries, they've built nomadic cities, withstood Catastrophe, even attempted to control the storm—
speaker: Theresis
content: Without a doubt. In a few short centuries, they've built nomadic cities, withstood Catastrophe, even attempted to control the storm—

raw: [name="Theresis"]Not to mention those knights of white steam. The valiance of those steel suits of armor that ventured into Kazdel, two hundred years ago, falls far short of that which I saw in the years to follow.
speaker: Theresis
content: Not to mention those knights of white steam. The valiance of those steel suits of armor that ventured into Kazdel, two hundred years ago, falls far short of that which I saw in the years to follow.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Ah... perhaps it's the fault of our unique blood, for granting so many of us lives far too long.
speaker: Theresa
content: Ah... perhaps it's the fault of our unique blood, for granting so many of us lives far too long.

raw: [name="Theresa"]So long that in the intervals between one war and the next, we lift our heads, only to realize that, excepting the Sarkaz, everyone is progressing on.
speaker: Theresa
content: So long that in the intervals between one war and the next, we lift our heads, only to realize that, excepting the Sarkaz, everyone is progressing on.

raw: [name="Theresis"]No, it's nothing to do with the length of an individual's life.
speaker: Theresis
content: No, it's nothing to do with the length of an individual's life.

raw: [name="Theresis"]They have the opportunity to progress, simply because in the past they monopolized the freedom to choose between peace and war.
speaker: Theresis
content: They have the opportunity to progress, simply because in the past they monopolized the freedom to choose between peace and war.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Theresa, when I look at Londinium, I see the number of times this nation has gone wrong.
speaker: Theresis
content: Theresa, when I look at Londinium, I see the number of times this nation has gone wrong.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The Victorians scorn how primitive the Sarkaz are, yet in essence they simply use the rules of the culture they founded to gild the greed and violence that runs in their deepest marrow.
speaker: Theresis
content: The Victorians scorn how primitive the Sarkaz are, yet in essence they simply use the rules of the culture they founded to gild the greed and violence that runs in their deepest marrow.

raw: [name="Theresis"]They tear at each other, incessantly. Ultimately, everything they've made will be ruined by their own hands.
speaker: Theresis
content: They tear at each other, incessantly. Ultimately, everything they've made will be ruined by their own hands.

raw: [name="Theresis"]That is why we could win this chance at freedom.
speaker: Theresis
content: That is why we could win this chance at freedom.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Even if hope is still as remote?
speaker: Theresa
content: Even if hope is still as remote?

raw: [name="Theresis"]I won't give up on any possibility.
speaker: Theresis
content: I won't give up on any possibility.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Yes... in that regard, we've always been so alike.
speaker: Theresa
content: Yes... in that regard, we've always been so alike.

content: Residence of the Duke of Cumberland, Auchterigg District of Londinium

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Amiya, Doctor, our Messenger has just sent back some key intel. The main Sarkaz forces are on their way back to the city right now. It's extremely likely this means they're about to wage war with the dukes' armies.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Amiya, Doctor, our Messenger has just sent back some key intel. The main Sarkaz forces are on their way back to the city right now. It's extremely likely this means they're about to wage war with the dukes' armies.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]But given previous intel, even if they do return to Londinium, the Sarkaz military won't be enough to directly contend with all the dukes.
speaker: Clovisia
content: But given previous intel, even if they do return to Londinium, the Sarkaz military won't be enough to directly contend with all the dukes.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]With the Sarkaz choosing to act now, they obviously believe they've grasped some key power that'll sway the situation for them.
speaker: Clovisia
content: With the Sarkaz choosing to act now, they obviously believe they've grasped some key power that'll sway the situation for them.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]That skyscraper the Sarkaz occupied? We've learned there's weaponry concealed in the building, yes, but—will it sway things?
speaker: Clovisia
content: That skyscraper the Sarkaz occupied? We've learned there's weaponry concealed in the building, yes, but—will it sway things?

raw: [name="Amiya"]It will, Clovisia. Have your people ever taken note... of the storm above The Shard?
speaker: Amiya
content: It will, Clovisia. Have your people ever taken note... of the storm above The Shard?

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Oh... those dark clouds seem highly unusual.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Oh... those dark clouds seem highly unusual.

raw: [name="Amiya"]According to the intel we've obtained, that's no normal storm at all. That's a Catastrophe The Shard is causing. Even if it isn't entirely the same as a true Catastrophe...
speaker: Amiya
content: According to the intel we've obtained, that's no normal storm at all. That's a Catastrophe The Shard is causing. Even if it isn't entirely the same as a true Catastrophe...

raw: [name="Clovisia"]The Sarkaz want to cause a Catastrophe? They're still in Londinium themselves. What would they gain from destroying the city?
speaker: Clovisia
content: The Sarkaz want to cause a Catastrophe? They're still in Londinium themselves. What would they gain from destroying the city?

raw: [Decision(options="They plan to weaponize the storm.;What if they control where the Catastrophe lands?", values="1;2")]
options: They plan to weaponize the storm.;What if they control where the Catastrophe lands?

speaker: Clovisia
content: Hrmm.

raw: [name="Amiya"]We're not just conjecturing The Shard's purpose. This weapon... or this technology, rather, is exactly Rhodes Island's chief objective in entering Londinium.
speaker: Amiya
content: We're not just conjecturing The Shard's purpose. This weapon... or this technology, rather, is exactly Rhodes Island's chief objective in entering Londinium.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Rhodes Island came for the clouds shrouding Londinium.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Rhodes Island came for the clouds shrouding Londinium.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Yes. It's not just a figure of speech.
speaker: Amiya
content: Yes. It's not just a figure of speech.

raw: [name="Amiya"]In the eventuality Theresis does activate The Shard, he'll lead the flames of war and the storm together, upon those he sees as the Sarkaz's enemies.
speaker: Amiya
content: In the eventuality Theresis does activate The Shard, he'll lead the flames of war and the storm together, upon those he sees as the Sarkaz's enemies.

raw: [name="Amiya"]No Catastrophe Messenger could predict a man-made Catastrophe's course. No nomadic city could escape such a Catastrophe's assault.
speaker: Amiya
content: No Catastrophe Messenger could predict a man-made Catastrophe's course. No nomadic city could escape such a Catastrophe's assault.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Countless Sarkaz and Victorians will die in that battle, and it'll likely be even more tragic for those who survive. Most of them will become Infected.
speaker: Amiya
content: Countless Sarkaz and Victorians will die in that battle, and it'll likely be even more tragic for those who survive. Most of them will become Infected.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Not to mention... The Shard isn't on the border, it's in Londinium, a nation's very capital...
speaker: Amiya
content: Not to mention... The Shard isn't on the border, it's in Londinium, a nation's very capital...

speaker: Clovisia
content: Which means...

raw: [Decision(options="Once the technology's complete, it'll reach anywhere on Terra.;......;We can only pray the tech hits further bottlenecks.", values="1;2;3")]
options: Once the technology's complete, it'll reach anywhere on Terra.;......;We can only pray the tech hits further bottlenecks.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]The Sarkaz... will use Victoria's power to destroy her.
speaker: Clovisia
content: The Sarkaz... will use Victoria's power to destroy her.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]If we reach that stage, then everything the Corps has done will be for naught.
speaker: Clovisia
content: If we reach that stage, then everything the Corps has done will be for naught.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Even if we could rescue people from a Catastrophe as Rhodes Island does... Londinium and our livelihood would be past any point of return.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Even if we could rescue people from a Catastrophe as Rhodes Island does... Londinium and our livelihood would be past any point of return.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Clovisia, Rhodes Island is greatly thankful to the Self-Salvation Corps. Without your help, we would've had no good way into Central Londinium.
speaker: Amiya
content: Clovisia, Rhodes Island is greatly thankful to the Self-Salvation Corps. Without your help, we would've had no good way into Central Londinium.

raw: [name="Amiya"]But neither I nor the Doctor will lie to you. No matter how Rhodes Island plans to approach The Shard, the battles ahead will be brutal. Each more brutal than the last.
speaker: Amiya
content: But neither I nor the Doctor will lie to you. No matter how Rhodes Island plans to approach The Shard, the battles ahead will be brutal. Each more brutal than the last.

raw: [name="Amiya"]If we can't stop Theresis within the next few days, we'll be facing an all-out war, and the dukes will march with an eye to enter Londinium.
speaker: Amiya
content: If we can't stop Theresis within the next few days, we'll be facing an all-out war, and the dukes will march with an eye to enter Londinium.

raw: [name="Amiya"]If the Corps chooses to wait for the dukes' armies...
speaker: Amiya
content: If the Corps chooses to wait for the dukes' armies...

speaker: Clovisia
content: Amiya... we can't do that.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]I'm the daughter of a textiles merchant. Most of the fighters, in fact, are just ordinary civilians.
speaker: Clovisia
content: I'm the daughter of a textiles merchant. Most of the fighters, in fact, are just ordinary civilians.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]We have workers, farmers, craftsmen, traders. Our backgrounds are a tapestry of millions, together under the one goal of driving the Sarkaz out of Londinium as soon as possible.
speaker: Clovisia
content: We have workers, farmers, craftsmen, traders. Our backgrounds are a tapestry of millions, together under the one goal of driving the Sarkaz out of Londinium as soon as possible.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]That's why the Corps won't place all its hopes in the dukes. Otherwise, we'd never have been able to take a stand ourselves.
speaker: Clovisia
content: That's why the Corps won't place all its hopes in the dukes. Otherwise, we'd never have been able to take a stand ourselves.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]Our greatest fear, if it came to it, wouldn't even be the Sarkaz controlling The Shard. It'd be... the dukes, dropping any shred of thought for the ramifications.
speaker: Clovisia
content: Our greatest fear, if it came to it, wouldn't even be the Sarkaz controlling The Shard. It'd be... the dukes, dropping any shred of thought for the ramifications.

raw: [name="Amiya"]So... the Corps has no intent to suspend operations?
speaker: Amiya
content: So... the Corps has no intent to suspend operations?

speaker: Clovisia
content: ...Correct.

raw: [name="Clovisia"]On the contrary, in fact. With war on the eve of breaking out, there are some things only the Self-Salvation Corps can do, here within Londinium.
speaker: Clovisia
content: On the contrary, in fact. With war on the eve of breaking out, there are some things only the Self-Salvation Corps can do, here within Londinium.

raw: [Decision(options="Such as wrecking the Sarkaz defensive line from the rear.;Such as gaining as much possible intel on Sarkaz supply lines.", values="1;2")]
options: Such as wrecking the Sarkaz defensive line from the rear.;Such as gaining as much possible intel on Sarkaz supply lines.
